card.name: Ohangla
card.era: Traditional; modern popular form since late 20th century
card.tagline: Fast, drum-driven Luo dance and popular music
card.profile: Ohangla is a traditional dance and musical style of the Luo community of western Kenya, built around a set of more than eight drums played with sticks plus a shoulder-slung cylindrical drum, often accompanied by a flute, nyatiti or orutu (Wikipedia). Historically performed at weddings and at funeral ceremonies (part of Tero Buru), it featured very fast tempos and frank lyrics; local elders banned it in the early 1980s as adult-only. It has since been revitalised into a hugely popular modern genre.
card.insight: Modern Ohangla now cuts across age groups and ethnic lines - performers such as Tony Nyadundo and Prince Indah have made it a fixture at weddings, festivals and political rallies far beyond the Luo community (Wikipedia).
